one_liner: Premium members, who pay to remove ads, see the same ad offer for saved slots.
author: claude-opus-5-5

change.trigger_event: A reader taps Save with 5 stories saved, which opens the saved-list-full pop-up
change.subscriber_treatment: Premium members see the same optional button. Their plan removes ads, but this is a game they choose to play, for saved space their plan doesn't include.

flow_steps.caption: A reader, free or Premium, with 5 saved stories taps Save on a sixth.
The pop-up shows the new button under Manage saved.
The reader plays a short game and can close it at any time.
The story is saved and the meter reads 'Saved: 6 of 8'.
